state_definition: [base_footprint x_room_m,y_room_m,yaw_room_rad] per vehicle; z not estimated; planar yaw rotation only
peer_correlation_policy: only car1->car2 updates joint state; reverse kept in observation audit, never averaged or counted as an independent simultaneous factor
range_timing_policy: individual mapped header time; bounded constant-body-twist projection from each latest arrived odometry anchor; reject older or unsupported measurements
publication_policy: hold per-vehicle last odometry-anchored posterior; publish receipt time and state measurement time separately

anchors_xyz_m.source: geometry.json anchors.xyz_m; historical measured mounts reused, uncertainty unknown
